description: This file contains implementations of linear algebra functions such as norm, svd, cross product, and LU solve, with references to PyTorch internals and custom decorators for decomposition and type promotion.

methods.name: _check_norm_dtype
methods.description: Checks that the dtype argument in norm functions is valid, ensuring it is float or complex and compatible with input dtype.

methods.name: cross
methods.description: Computes the cross product of two tensors along a specified dimension.

methods.name: diagonal
methods.description: Returns the diagonal of a tensor with specified offset and dimensions.

methods.name: _check_vector_norm_args
methods.description: Validates arguments for vector_norm, ensuring non-empty tensors and valid dimensions.

methods.name: vector_norm
methods.description: Calculates the vector norm of a tensor with support for various orders and dimensions.

methods.name: _backshift_permutation
methods.description: Helper to compute permutation moving two dimensions to the back.

methods.name: _inverse_permutation
methods.description: Computes the inverse of a given permutation.

methods.name: matrix_norm
methods.description: Calculates the matrix norm, supporting Frobenius, nuclear, and other norms.

methods.name: norm
methods.description: General norm function that delegates to vector_norm or matrix_norm based on input and parameters.

methods.name: svd
methods.description: Computes the singular value decomposition of a tensor.

methods.name: svdvals
methods.description: Returns the singular values of a tensor.

methods.name: vecdot
methods.description: Computes the dot product of two vectors, supporting complex conjugation.

methods.name: _pivots_to_permutation
methods.description: Converts pivot indices to a permutation tensor, optionally inverted.

methods.name: _apply_pivots
methods.description: Applies pivot permutations to a tensor.

methods.name: linalg_lu_solve_out_mps
methods.description: Performs LU solve with optional adjoint and left/right configuration, writing result to output.
